Field Log 02 Project documentation

Building
a home
office.

Follow the build ↓

Davie, Florida · October–November 2026

↓ Scroll to zoom in and build the room

Day 01 / October 13

Start with
a bare room.

In an 11′11″ × 13′5″ room, the crew rolls out floor protection, cuts the slats to 93 inches, and test-fits the first panel.

09:24 The first 56 wall panels come from MI.ELITE in Hialeah.

Day 02 / October 14

Set the
edges.

The crew works along the ceiling line and touches up the baseboards. By the afternoon check, the first test panel has been taken down.

16:42 A check of the room shows the crown and baseboard work.

Days 03–04 / October 16–19

Four shelves.
No visible brackets.

The crew opens the drywall on both sides. Birch plywood from IMECA goes to Kavins Custom Cabinetry. Back on site, three steel braces per shelf fasten into studs and sit inside the shelf profile.

18:06 · Oct 19 The east shelves are up, bringing the room to four.

Days 05–07 / October 20–22

The panels
go up.

Slats go up across three walls. After a supply run for cabinet feet, the crew picks up the cut parts, pulls the floor protection, and assembles the cabinet boxes.

18:27 · Oct 22 The uncovered floor and assembled cabinet boxes are visible.

Days 08–09 / October 27–28

Inside the
walk-in closet.

Base cabinets line three sides. A U-shaped countertop ties them together, with open shelves above and a soffit over the top.

Oct 27 Short slats are cut to fit between the counter and soffit. Bare areas of the window wall are filled in the next day.

Days 10–11 / October 29–30

Two built-in
workstations.

Each desktop bridges two cabinet pedestals, leaving knee space in the middle and keeping both floating shelves within reach.

Oct 29–30 Drawer boxes are assembled at the carpenter’s shop, a fan replaces the old ceiling cap, and the crew picks up drawer slides and panels.

Days 12–13 / November 6–9

Drawers, doors,
and light.

Drawer fronts and bar pulls finish the desks. LED strips under the closet shelves wash light down the slats. The base cabinets get fitted doors and matching pulls.

Nov 9 · 18:21 The evening walkthrough shows both workstations and the lit closet.

Day 14 / November 10

The last
pieces.

The crew fits the last slats under the desk and mounts the white blinds inside the window return. The camera pulls back to show the completed office.

See the finished room ↘

Site footage / November 2026

The finished
home office.

Acoustic slats wrap the room. Two built-in workstations sit beneath floating shelves, with drawer storage on both sides. The closet has its own lit shelving and cabinetry.
